definitions.explanation: Given or done without payment or reward. More formal than {無料|むりょう}, and also used for help or love given without expecting anything back.

examples.japanese: {無償|むしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: To provide something free of charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→保証：03718_hoshou⟧⟦{期間|きかん}{中|ちゅう}→期間中：23950_kikanchuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無償|むしょう}です。
examples.english: Repairs during the warranty period are free of charge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧{無償|むしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めない→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The unconditional love parents give their children asks for nothing in return.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無償|むしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: free of charge, without pay
- {無償|むしょう}⟦{提供|ていきょう}→提供：12909_teikyou⟧: free provision
- {無償|むしょう}{化|か}: making something free (⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無償|むしょう}{化|か}, abolishing tuition fees)
- {無償|むしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: unconditional love

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free; the everyday word for goods and services offered to customers (⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧). {無償|むしょう} appears in contracts, official notices, and policy, and in the sense "without reward".
- The opposite is {有償|ゆうしょう} (for a fee, paid).
